title: 订单数
question: 近 30 天每天的订单数
sql:
SELECT
  o.order_date AS date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  o.order_date
ORDER BY
  date
LIMIT 1000

  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count

    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id

    store_id IN ('S01')
